headline: Garuda Construction files financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
summary: Garuda Construction and Engineering Limited has officially submitted its financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. This routine regulatory filing provides the company's financial performance data for the second quarter of the fiscal year. Shareholders and prospective investors can review the reported revenue, margins, and net profit figures on the exchange portals. The update enables retail investors to track the company's operational execution against prior quarters.
why_it_matters: Quarterly numbers reveal the fundamental performance of your holdings.

headline: Garuda Construction sets October record date for dividend
hook: October record date for Garuda payout
summary: Garuda Construction and Engineering Limited has informed the stock exchange that October 23, 2026, will serve as the record date for its upcoming dividend distribution. Shareholders holding the company's shares as of this date will be eligible for the payout. Routine corporate actions of this nature directly impact the cash returns for current equity holders. Indian retail investors tracking income-yielding stocks should note the specific calendar date to qualify.
why_it_matters: Qualifying shareholders receive a cash dividend payout.

headline: Garuda Construction declares an interim dividend of Rs 0.03 per share
hook: Small interim payout for construction holders
summary: Garuda Construction and Engineering Limited announced an interim dividend of Rs 0.03 per equity share following its board meeting on October 15, 2026. This routine corporate payout applies to shareholders holding the company's equity as of the record date. For Indian retail investors, small dividend announcements from micro-cap stocks offer minor cash returns but typically have negligible impact on broader market trends.
why_it_matters: Nominal cash payout for existing shareholders.
